title: PA Cycles — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An appraisal cycle for the 360-style appraisal — for example "2026 Annual". Every appraisal names its cycle, and an appraisal cannot be submitted to workflow without one.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: IsDefault
fields.html:
What it is. Whether this cycle is the one offered by default.

Why it matters. Not read at present.
